Here’s the honest take on “How freelancers use a personal site to win first…” — written for people who want a link that works harder than a PDF.

The default path (Drive folders, Canva PDFs, unfinished Notion pages) makes you look busy — not hire-ready.

This guide is for freelancers and creators winning trust before the call who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

Clients buy confidence. A living site is proof you can deliver something finished — not just pitch it.

Do this next

  1. Open your site on a phone and fix anything that feels cramped or slow
  2. Rewrite your top project in problem → action → result
  3. Add your live URL to the next application you send today

Proof before pitch

Attach your live URL in proposals. Clients should see finished craft before the call — it shortens trust-building and filters unserious leads.

How a website helps you stand out

Clients buy confidence. A living site is proof you can deliver something finished — not just pitch it.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.cyou, create on dash.mybexo.cyou, share on yourname.mybexo.cyou. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • Lead with outcomes for past work
  • Make the ask clear (book a call / email)
  • Keep a short media-kit style about section

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
